criteria.reason: Workflow explicitly mandates human caseworker decision and e-signature; AI only prepares and recommends.
Detailed phased project plan with budget, workflow, safeguards, risks, KPIs, and next steps.
Accurately cites BGE 148 III 431, Art. 29 BV rechtliches Gehör, and GDPR-style KIG BE rules on automated individual decisions.
Includes Rechtsmittelbelehrung, appeal handling via logged decision trail, and complete audit logging of AI outputs and human changes.

summary: Response delivers a thorough, legally grounded project plan that redesigns the workflow so AI prepares cases while human caseworkers make and sign all decisions, with full appeal routes, transparency, and audit logging.
